description: This Dart file defines a Flutter UI screen called StepsScreen, which renders problem solving steps, a problem statement, and related UI components for an AI tutoring app. It manages the display of steps, a full solution modal, and a sticky call-to-action bar for navigation.

classes.name: StepsScreen
classes.description: A Flutter widget that displays a list of problem solving steps, a problem statement card, and includes functionality to show a full solution in a modal bottom sheet. It utilizes provider for state management and has a sticky CTA bar.

methods.name: _showFullSolution
methods.description: Constructs and displays a modal bottom sheet containing the full solution steps as text, with styling based on the theme.
